source: West Virginia Tax Division 2026 withholding tables (S.B. 392, signed Mar 31, 2026, 5% rate cut retroactive to Jan 1, 2026; withholding effective Jun 12, 2026): rates 2.11%/2.81%/3.16%/4.22%/4.58% at $10,000/$25,000/$40,000/$60,000; $2,000 personal exemption per exemption. CLOSEST-FIT EXCEPTIONS: (1) two-earner/two-jobs withholding table (thresholds 75% of standard) not modeled — default one-earner/one-job table encoded for all statuses; (2) zero-exemption filers may claim only a reduced $500 exemption on the return — engine exempts $0 for allowances=0 (conservative).
